name: Synaptic Reroute (Psionic)
body:
The fluidity of your mental processes allows you to retrain your skills.

Prerequisite: Open Minded, elan.

Benefit: When attaining a new level, you can can choose to reallocate up to three skill points spent at prior levels, moving them to new skills. You may not reduce ranks in a skill to a point where you no longer meet the prerequisites for feats or other abilities that you possess.
